benchmark_description: Synthetic benchmark. Expected results were written by hand from the source rules, not generated by running the engine. Same author as the engine: not independent validation.

unknown_handling.notes: 35 checks where unknown was the right answer

false_not_met.notes: a student wrongly told a condition is not met

citation_validity.notes: 234 ledger entries; source url, passage and check date must match the catalog

unsupported_claims.notes: independent audit of final user-visible explanations

extraction_leaks.notes: sensitive strings echoed in profile or warnings

urdu_ledger_completion.notes: every ledger entry fully in Urdu (reasoning text only, not model quality)

eligibility_latency_ms.notes: median per case; max 0.172 ms (deterministic code, no model)

guard_decisions.notes: explanations accepted/rejected as expected (tests our validator on scripted replies)

urdu_extraction_relative.notes: needs a live model; scripted mode only exercises the validation pipeline

retrieval_recall.notes: no document retrieval layer exists yet; the catalog is curated and looked up directly

end_to_end_success.notes: needs real-browser tests; the web app has not been run in an automated browser
